thresholdOverrides.reason: The Folio desk prints the viewer, the text layer, the OCR pass, the protect dialog, and the tabs from one document state. Components are E2E territory in this repo, so unit coverage is zero by design and CRAP reads complexity alone; the browser suite is the acceptance.

The Folio workers, their clients, and the byte verifier are the PDF engine boundary. Their branches follow the page protocol, the compression and flattening passes, the OCR and wording-edit transactions, and the save/reopen fixture suite; the client moves one request at a time.

FolioExtract prints the extract desk: the page grid, the text edits, the OCR pass, and the download states from one document state. Components are E2E territory in this repo, so unit coverage is zero by design and CRAP reads complexity alone; the browser suite is the acceptance.

The app shell, the reload prompt, and the language menu print navigation, update, and locale state. Components are E2E territory in this repo, so unit coverage is zero by design and CRAP reads complexity alone.

Byte-level container parsers mirror the JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, GIF, JUMBF, CBOR, DNG, OOXML, and ISO-BMFF specifications. Their branch count is format shape, not product branching; the reader and writer fixtures are the acceptance.
readFile walks one container once and prints the field list. Its branches follow the tag families the reader accepts; the reader fixtures are the acceptance.
sniffFormat is a flat signature table over the supported containers. Each branch names one magic number, so the count grows with the format list rather than product logic.
inspect decodes the TIFF, IFD, and DNG tag grammar of one container. Its branches follow the DNG specification; the DNG fixtures are the acceptance.
The cleaner, the worker, and the browser engine seam map one clean request to the engine state machine and its message shape. Their branches follow the engine protocol.
The writer ports translate one clean request into ExifTool arguments and errors. Their branching follows the tool's argument surface.
The session hook maps the named engine states to one page state. Splitting the state table across hooks would spread one switch across files.
The desk components print the report, the locator, the order, and the receipt from one report shape. Their cognitive load is the printed state table and the per-format preview branches.
The glyph atlas is written by a build script (bun brand:gen), not shipped runtime code, so it has no unit coverage. Its branches map OpenType path commands one-to-one.
The tabular engine mirrors the CSV, BIFF, OOXML, and SpreadsheetML grammars and one command set. Its branch count follows those formats, and the fixture plus branch tests are the acceptance.

The Tabular desk prints the parse, grid, dialog, and export states from one session shape. Components are E2E territory in this repo, so unit coverage is zero by design and CRAP reads complexity alone. The 26 browser tests and the recorded captures are the acceptance.

The route hook maps the named engine states to one page state and owns focus, selection, and clipboard recovery. Splitting that state table across hooks would spread one switch across files, as with use-expose. The browser tests are the acceptance.
parseText validates the strict CSV quote grammar before Papa Parse runs. Its branch count follows the delimited-text grammar, and the parser fixtures plus branch tests are the acceptance.
The PWA check waits on a live server built by the smoke job, so the retry loop has no unit coverage.

TabularDiff prints the Diff desk: the sheet choices, the key editor, the filter, the paging, and the report actions from one plan shape. Its branches map one-to-one to the visible controls that the browser suite exercises.
TabularPage composes every Tabular panel and its open, split, merge, diff, chart, and export states. The branches select one panel at a time; the browser suite exercises each flow.
TabularSplit maps the Split Part form and its progress states. The branches follow the form fields, not product flow.
TabularMerge prints the Merge Source order, the column match, and the plan receipts from one merge state. The browser suite is the acceptance.
buildDiffPlan walks the two headers once to pair keys and columns. Its branches are the header, key, and row guards, and the unit tests cover each guard.
buildMergePlan aligns columns across sources by header or by position. The branches follow the two alignment modes, and the unit tests cover both.
writePdf draws one section per Sheet and verifies the envelope in one pass. The unit tests cover the writer, the empty report, and the verification guards.
The chart models map a column range to one SVG shape. Their branches follow the five chart types and the data guards, and the unit tests cover each model.
readFormat4 decodes the TrueType cmap segments and wrapCount walks one word per line. Their branches follow the font and text grammars, and the crafted-font tests cover each path.
The chart hook is a React seam outside the unit coverage scope. Its CRAP score comes from the fixed hook wiring, and the browser suite is the acceptance.

The Qraft hook maps the settings state to the browser render, download, copy, print, and Batch calls. Hooks and components are E2E territory in this repo, so unit coverage is zero by design and CRAP reads complexity alone; the browser suite is the acceptance.

The Qraft core is one registry over the Symbology set. validatePayload, renderMatrixSvg, matrixOf2d, scanWarnings, and validatePostal branch once per standard; the unit tests cover every preset, postal standard, and PNG path.

The Qraft desk prints Payload, Code, Style, Preview, Batch, and Explainer from one settings state. Components are E2E territory in this repo, so unit coverage is zero by design and CRAP reads complexity alone; the browser suite is the acceptance.

buildPreset is one flat switch over the Preset catalog, and rasterOfSettings maps one settings object to the options each Symbology accepts. Their branches follow the preset and Symbology lists; the unit tests cover every preset, postal standard, and PNG path.
